Chicken Wing Pasta—with absolutely no wings required. 😄🌶️

This creamy Buffalo pasta is one of our family’s favorite ways to turn cooked chicken breast or thigh into a warm, cheesy meal.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

• 1 lb penne pasta
• 8 oz cream cheese
• ½ cup Frank’s RedHot Wing Sauce
• 1 cup chicken broth
• 1 tsp garlic powder
• 1 tsp kosher salt
• 1 lb cooked, shredded chicken breast or thigh
• 1 cup shredded mozzarella
• 1 cup shredded cheddar
• Optional: ¼ cup ranch or blue cheese dressing

HOW TO MAKE IT:

Cook the pasta according to the package directions.

While it cooks, combine the cream cheese, Buffalo sauce, and chicken broth in a large skillet. Simmer over medium heat, stirring constantly, until smooth.

Whisk in the garlic powder and salt, then stir in the shredded chicken. Fold in the cooked pasta and both cheeses. Remove from the heat and serve warm with ranch or blue cheese dressing, if desired.
